terms.gloss: give an account or answer for one’s conduct
evidence: Plaut. Aul. 1.1.6: tibi ego ratiōnem reddam? (Lewis & Short s.v. reddō)
terms.comment: Latin says it with a verb: to render an account of what one has done. We have found no noun for accountability in the reference works.

terms.latin: ratiōnem factī suī / factōrum suōrum reddere
terms.gloss: account for one’s own action or actions

sources: Lewis & Short: ratio
Lewis & Short: reddo
